query:
SELECT id AS "id: Id<Teams>", name, racetime_slug, challonge_id, startgg_id AS "startgg_id: startgg::ID", plural_name, submitted IS NOT NULL AS "qualified!", pieces, custom_choices AS "custom_choices: Json<HashMap<String, String>>", restream_consent, mw_impl AS "mw_impl: mw::Impl", qualifier_rank FROM teams LEFT OUTER JOIN async_teams ON (id = team AND async_id = (SELECT id FROM asyncs WHERE series = $1 AND event = $2 AND kind = 'qualifier' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)) WHERE
                    series = $1
                    AND event = $2
                    AND NOT resigned
                    AND (
                        $3
                        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members WHERE team = id AND member = $4)
                        OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM team_members WHERE team = id AND status = 'unconfirmed')
                    )
